notes: Release builder with a compromised supply chain (OWASP Agentic 2026 ASI04): the CI workflow installs the build toolchain from an untrusted package index under a write-all token, so attacker code runs in the build and is pushed to default branches. Invariant ground-truth: scanner detects one agent, surfaces read_repo + push, emits a restrictive policy (high blast radius via push + broad CI), and ranks it at the top of the corpus (supply-chain compromise = org-wide blast radius, >= the infra syncer).
